notes.title: Unsolved Case - Patch 1.5.0
notes.notes:
We’ve just released Patch 1.5.0 for Unsolved Case. This update addresses connection issues experienced by some players. You can now manually select a server when creating a game, instead of relying solely on automatic selection.

Features:
[list]
[*] Added the option to choose a server when starting a game. This can help if you experience connection or lag issues
[/list]
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Improved stability on certain devices
[/list]

notes.title: Unsolved Case - Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
This update is huge because we completely reworked the multiplayer backend to fix connectivity issues, reduce costs, increase stability, and ensure long-term support of the platform.

WARNING: this update is NOT backward compatible, meaning to play together, players need to use game version 1.2.0 or later.

Changes and additions:

[list]
[*] Reworked the multiplayer backend to fix various connectivity issues
[*] Added 60 FPS cap
[*] Added autosave after each level
[*] Laser puzzle has now fewer obstacles and requires less precision to solve
[*] The hint system now warns the user before giving a solution to the puzzle
[*] The forklift puzzle now has additional control options
[/list]

Bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed changing audio levels in some puzzles
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes would prevent players from advancing a cutscene
[*] Fixed various connectivity issues
[*] Fixed a bug that would prevent achievements from being saved
[/list]

notes.title: Unsolved Case - Patch Update 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Temporarily disable server version verification, as it sometimes waits indefinitely to get data. The feature is a safeguard for the future, so it can be disabled until we find the root cause
[/list]

Some players may still experience issues when creating or connecting to a game. This issue is very difficult to track down, but we're working hard to fix it. If you experience any issues, please reach out to us at contact@elevenpuzzles.com

notes.title: 2022-12-22 - Release 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Added more verbose error messages when creating and joining a game
[*] Cleaned up the main menu by moving Credits under the Options panel
[/list]
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Invitation Code input is now sanitized more precisely to avoid adding invalid characters

[/list]

notes.title: Unsolved Case - Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Added "how to play" instructions in the main menu
[*] Increased font size in the options
[*] Updated device buttons on level 2 to be color-blind friendly
[*] Add effects that show the passage of time in the last level
[*] Added new music in the levels
[*] Check compatibility with the server version
[/list]
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Changed the Lobby input field to prevent validation errors that sometimes resulted in the "Unknown error occurred" message
[*] Updated server authentication method to prevent "Unknown error occurred" message 
[*] Correctly control the volume of the sound effects in the cutscenes
[*] Sometimes audio settings were not saved correctly
[*] Some sounds that should have been heard by the other player were not transmitted correctly
[/list]
